exposure: arterial pH < 7.20 for the first twin
cohort: Twin pregnancies delivered at ≥23 weeks of gestation at a tertiary hospital
finding: Chorionicity was not associated with umbilical cord blood acid-base parameters or neonatal outcomes in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Chorionicity was not associated with umbilical cord blood acid-base parameters in either the first or second twin, and no differences in neonatal outcomes were observed based on chorionicity or birth order.
